kind.description: Nuxie spring easings. 0 spring: a critically damped step on smoothstepped time, k = 8p + 3.5, u = t²(3 − 2t), (1 − e^(−ku)(1 + ku)) / (1 − e^(−k)(1 + k)). 1 bouncy: an underdamped step, ω = 8p + 10, ζ = clamp(0.55 − 0.35p, 0.05, 0.9), ω_d = ω√(1 − ζ²), osc(t) = 1 − e^(−ζωt)(cos ω_d t + ζ/√(1 − ζ²) · sin ω_d t), divided by osc(1). Both end exactly on the next key's value. Any other kind eases linearly. Readers without the type skip the record, and the key plays linearly.

strength.description: The strength p, clamped to 0 to 1; not a number reads as 0.6.
